summary: Angel Oak Mortgage REIT filed an 8-K under Item 1.01 disclosing that on September 25, 2026, it and two subsidiaries extended a loan financing facility with Multinational Bank 1. The facility, previously expiring September 25, 2026, now runs through December 28, 2026, under rolling three-month renewals, and the interest-rate spread was cut to a 1.20%-2.10% range from 1.30%-2.10%. No special-situation event, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are present; this is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a transaction. Watch for further short-dated extensions or a term-out as a liquidity signal.
